answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 9144 Country: India Title: Assalam-o-alaykum, I saw today morning in my dream that one of my friend is weeping and telling me that he has got a very bad disease and I am thinking (in that dream) is that disease happened to me too or not. Please help me in this regard. Assalam-o-alaykum. Question: Assalam-o-alaykum, I saw today morning in my dream that one of my friend is weeping and telling me that he has got a very bad disease and I am thinking (in that dream) is that disease happened to me too or not. Please help me in this regard. Assalam-o-alaykum. Answer ID: 9144 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2333/1822=H/1429) It means that you both are negligent of following sunnah. The dream is warning to remove this negligence. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
